topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Can you believe they've been living right next door to us, all these years, and we had no idea they were swimming in money? I mean, think about it—fancy vacations they never mentioned, the luxury car that just showed up out of nowhere, and now we find out about the charity gala they host like it's nothing? The nerve of some people. Here we all are, struggling, and they don't even lift a finger to help. Not a word. It's just... it's just too much. I can't even begin to tell you how much I need a drink right now, or a really, really good rant. I wish you were here. We'd figure out what to do about this, right?
